flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: The membership renews automatically for successive 12-month terms at the then-current rate without any fresh signature, so it does not end on its own at the end of the initial term.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: Missing the cancellation deadline commits the member to a further full 12-month term at whatever rate is then current, and notice given even one day late only takes effect at the end of that following term, with all dues for it payable in full.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, hours, the class timetable and the terms of this agreement at any time, with the changes applying from the date of posting, and the member is treated as accepting them just by continuing to use the facility — with no cap on how much fees or terms can change and no right to leave without penalty stated in the clause.

flags.sourceSentence: Your continued use of any facility after an amended version is posted is your acceptance of it.
flags.consequence: The member is treated as accepting posted amendments to the agreement simply by continuing to use any facility, without signing anything or actively agreeing.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian is not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential or punitive damages, for lost income or lost business opportunity, or for loss of or damage to property brought onto club premises, including property left in a locker.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees paid in the prior 12 months, and it is not liable at all for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to the member's property, including property left in a locker.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The member must pay for, defend against and hold Meridian harmless from any third-party claim arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, a guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member, with Meridian choosing the lawyer and the member unable to settle without Meridian's consent — an open-ended obligation that could exceed anything the member pays in dues.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after their Program candidacy ends for any reason, the member cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training — as employee, contractor or on their own account — anywhere within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction, which could block their livelihood in the fitness field.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The member gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join any class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes must go to a single-arbitrator binding arbitration whose award is final.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: A membership that is suspended, frozen or on medical hold keeps renewing on its original schedule, so the member can incur dues for further 12-month terms while unable to use the facility.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late payment triggers a charge whose amount is not stated in this document but sits in a separate Schedule of Fees the member must look up, alongside returned-payment, keycard replacement and account reinstatement charges, all of which are drawn from the member's payment method.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: A candidate who falls short of the expected 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year can be held back a year at Meridian's discretion, extending the time and tuition needed to finish.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program enrolment renews automatically each year at the then-current tuition, which may be higher than the rate the member originally paid, unless the member gives written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date.

flags.sourceSentence: You may opt out of this Section 12 by delivering written notice to the address in Section 11 within thirty (30) days after you ﬁrst accept this Agreement, and opting out will not affect your membership or your standing in the Program.
flags.consequence: The member has only 30 days from first accepting the agreement to opt out of the arbitration and jury-trial waiver in writing; after that the waiver applies to all disputes, including serious ones.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The member is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so unauthorised or mistaken use of their card or account by someone else could lead to charges or rule violations attributed to them.

flags.sourceSentence: You agree to keep the contact details, billing details and emergency contact on your account current, and to tell Member Services in writing of any change within ten (10) days.
flags.consequence: The member must keep account details current and notify Meridian in writing of any change within 10 days, and a failure to do so could mean notices (including fee changes and renewal-related notices) are sent to an outdated email or address while still counting as given.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The member authorises ongoing automatic draws of all dues, tuition and charges from their payment method until the agreement ends and the balance is nil, so charges continue to be taken without a fresh authorisation each time.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the signer ends the licence early, they lose the unused part of the $45 season fee; the Association keeps it with no refund, even though it refunds proportionally when it ends the licence itself.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any of the signer's belongings left on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames, tools or other items — becomes the Association's property to keep or throw away, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the signer's subscription fee with 30 days' email notice, with no cap on the increase and no stated right to cancel without paying the higher rate, so the signer could be locked into a higher price on renewal.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to another full twelve-month term at whatever the annual fee then is, which could be a large, higher charge.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can change any term of the agreement — including pricing, remedies, and the Fee Schedule — at any time by posting it, and the signer is bound just by continuing to use the service, with no cap on what can change and no stated right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for anything going wrong — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is capped at what the signer paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, so a serious loss (for example, a year of design work destroyed) could recover at most one month's or one year's fee depending on the plan.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay for Northwind's defence of any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — including claims about copyright, trade mark or privacy — an obligation that is open-ended and could exceed anything the signer pays Northwind.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind for any dispute about the service, including claims over lost work or failed exports, and must instead pursue a single arbitrator's final, binding decision individually.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment accrues interest at 1.5% per month (18% annually) with no cap stated, and the signer must also pay a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule on Northwind's support site that was not provided, so the total cost of a lapsed payment is unknown.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work or a failed export — the signer's only recovery is a service credit defined in a policy document that was not supplied, and cannot recover anything beyond that, however large the loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: The signer's account can be suspended on Northwind's belief alone that more than one person is using it, cutting off access to the editor and stored work while the matter is investigated, with no stated notice or time limit.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically each Billing Period without a fresh signature, and the signer is billed the fee then in effect unless they cancel in advance; it does not end on its own.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, they pay for the whole period but lose access at period's end with no refund of the fee already collected.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change, withdraw or reinterpret any policy, benefit or term of employment — including terms described in this offer — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the change taking effect as soon as it is published on the company intranet. The clause names no cap on changes, no advance notice period, and no right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the Restricted Field (defined in Exhibit B, which was not provided), as employee, contractor, consultant, adviser or principal, limiting their ability to earn a living in their field.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses and attorney fees arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality/non-compete sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job breaches an obligation to that employer — an open-ended amount.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to go to court with a jury and the right to join a class, collective or representative action for any employment-related claim, including statutory claims; all disputes go to individual binding arbitration instead.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is fired for cause in the first year, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of their last working day, even if they worked most of that year.

flags.sourceSentence: For the same period you will not solicit, or assist anyone else in soliciting, any employee of Ardent with whom you worked in your final twelve months, and you will not approach any customer, distributor or contract manufacturer of Ardent that you dealt with in that period for the purpose of providing a product or service in the Restricted Field.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends, the signer cannot solicit Ardent employees they worked with or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with, on pain of the acknowledgment that breach causes harm 'money alone would not repair' — opening the door to injunctive action.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must maintain full-value insurance on stored property and produce evidence on request; if they do not, they bear the entire risk of loss, and the Operator's own liability for loss or damage — including damage caused by the Operator's negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for and defend the Operator against every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense — including attorney fees — brought by anyone arising from the occupant's use of the unit or premises, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant allows on site, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can unilaterally change the agreement's terms, the posted rules, and gate hours by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month — no occupant agreement, no cap on what can be changed, and no right to leave without penalty stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: Unpaid rent or charges give the Operator a lien on everything in the unit, allowing it to deny access, overlock the unit, and after the required notice period sell the occupant's contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed — potentially losing property worth far more than the debt.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The Operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice with no stated cap, and the occupant's only option is to accept the increase or end the agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent triggers a late charge, and every further notice the Operator sends about the unpaid balance adds another administration charge; the amounts are set in a Schedule of Charges the occupant may not have seen, so the total cost of a late month is unknown and can grow with each notice.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself month to month automatically with no end date; it will not terminate on its own, and the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop owing rent.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where the Operator reasonably believes the contents present a danger, and will leave notice of the entry in or on the unit.
flags.consequence: The Operator can enter the occupant's unit to inspect it or make repairs without the occupant's presence or prior notice, leaving only after-the-fact notice in or on the unit.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the occupant moves out during a month, the rent already paid for that month is kept by the Operator with no refund, so the occupant pays for storage time they will not use.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term — missing that deadline commits the signer to a further year at a higher, stated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan before its term ends does not cancel the device instalment plan, and the entire unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on the next bill — an amount that could be large depending on the device and months remaining.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan, with the change taking effect on a date stated in a notice sent by bill, device message or email. The clause names no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty except for material increases to the monthly recurring charge (30-day cancellation window).

flags.sourceSentence: Continuing to use the service after the effective date of a change accepts the change.
flags.consequence: Using the service after a change's effective date counts as accepting it, so the signer can be bound to new terms without signing anything.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising from their use of the service, anything sent from or stored on their device, use of the line by anyone they allow to use it, and any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action; disputes go to individual binding arbitration. The document does provide a 30-day window after activation to reject the arbitration provision in writing without affecting service or rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: Cascade can introduce, increase or remove the Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and the Administrative Charge — which the document states are not government-required — on notice given with the bill where the change first appears, so the monthly bill can grow by amounts outside the agreed rate plan.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance, applied every bill period until the balance is paid, so the charge compounds on an ongoing shortfall.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is capped at the service charges for the affected line for a single bill period, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss — so recovery for a serious service failure is limited to roughly one month of charges.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a monthly plan has no fixed term and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled.
flags.consequence: Monthly-plan service continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled and does not end on its own, so the signer keeps being billed unless they actively cancel.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme early for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the stipend and the programme experience with no compensation beyond the week of notice.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time by email, with the change taking effect immediately from the date of the email — including changes to pay-related terms, obligations and rules the Analyst must observe — with no cap, no advance notice period and no right to leave without penalty stated.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement — paid or unpaid, as employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on the Restricted List, which is confidential, may be reissued during the Programme, and whose contents the Analyst cannot fully know in advance, and cannot approach any client whose file they worked on.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm for any claim, loss or expense, including legal costs, arising from a breach of the confidentiality or post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client — an open-ended amount with no cap, covering even non-financial publications.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute — including over termination, stipend or the restrictive covenants — through individual binding arbitration, removing court and group-action routes for serious problems.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late housing-advance instalment accrues a late charge, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook (not shown in this document), that continues to grow until the advance is repaid in full, on top of the instalment deductions already coming out of the stipend.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation has no end date, so the Analyst could face exposure indefinitely after the Programme for any client name, model, memorandum or data set they saw, and must not retain any copies.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: If the laptop, security token or building pass is not returned within five working days of the last day, the Analyst is charged the replacement cost stated in the Programme Handbook, an amount not visible in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: If the place is given up within seven days of the first lesson but before the third lesson, the signer loses half the fee — $60 of the $120 paid.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the place is given up after the third lesson, the signer loses the entire $120 fee for the remaining lessons the child will not attend.
